mintAuthority.summary: USDf has one proven native issuance deployment on Ethereum. Its transparent proxy is administered through a zero-delay ProxyAdmin owned by a 4/6 Safe, while the Ethereum PreCollateralizedMinter authorizes native minting through signed requests without an on-chain collateral check or supply cap; BSC, Base, and XDC transfer-rail controls are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: USDf default admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770829 on 2026-08-16, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the USDf proxy remained held by Safe 0x1e482b60bf19cb1cc859389e0ea3ded153f16bd7. Current reads confirmed six owners, threshold 4, and no enabled Safe modules; getGuard() reverted and no current guard value is assumed. The Safe controls the token role-admin path and the zero-delay ProxyAdmin, so it can authorize or replace native minters and mint logic.

controls.label: USDf PreCollateralizedMinter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770829 on 2026-08-16, MINTER_ROLE on the USDf proxy remained held by PreCollateralizedMinter 0x3a4f41dac6000a59b79669b9356b5eb71bf4cc59. Its verified preCollateralizedMint path checks a collateral reference, amount, recipient, expiry, nonce, and issuer signature before calling USDF.mint, but it does not escrow collateral, check collateral balances, enforce on-chain OCR, or impose a supply cap.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770829 on 2026-08-16, the USDf proxy resolved to implementation 0x3adf34c09dac24e4baefb1b1df4c2992edc2b789 with ProxyAdmin 0x3ef1127fdf81b553066dae0faea58785a2aa6e14 owned by the reviewed 4-of-6 Safe. The Ethereum PreCollateralizedMinter remains the native MINTER_ROLE holder; its signed issuance path has no on-chain collateral balance check or supply cap. BSC, Base, and XDC BurnMintERC20 roles, pools, local unlimited-supply semantics, and CCIP route administration are bridge machinery and are recorded only in bridgeRouteRisk. The corrected native annotations remain partially-bounded-admin, unbounded, periodic reconciliation, and attestation-only supervision.
